messages:
maya.marketing: Quick idea  run a 'Fastpath' PLG launch tied to webinar posts + a tiny benchmark teaser. Hypothesis: $10 credits + 3 starter prompts + smarter routing => +8% first-run within 48h. Run 7 days. Thoughts?

ryan.growth: Like it. Recommend 3 arms: control, credits-only ($10), credits+templates+1 nudged toast. N per arm ~600.

jules.content: Post drafts:
A) "Fastpath: $10 + starter prompts to ship an LLM feature in minutes."
B) "Fastpath benchmark: same latency, ~22% token savings. Try with $10."
I'll make 1 hero gif per variant.

kai.ops: Routing plan: tag webinar signups with cohort=fastpath then push grant. Pseudocode:
```
if (event.source === 'webinar' && event.campaign === 'fastpath-launch') {
  analytics.identify(userId, { fastpath_cohort: true });
  grants.enqueue({ userId, amount: 10, experiment: 'fastpath_2025' });
}
```
Make grants idempotent; soft daily cap 45k tokens for cohort.

priya.rs: Eval prompts: "summarize notes", "turn bullets into tasks", "rewrite outreach". We'll log tokens, latency, and a binary quality pass from a 10% manual sample. Export per-user metrics.

ryan.growth: Nudge flow for arm 3: immediate in-app toast with 1-click run; email Day2 with 3 templates; Day5 office hours invite. Keep all copy <2 lines.

jules.content: Landing microcopy: hero, 3-step checklist (claim $10, run demo, see benchmark). CTA: "Try Fastpath". I'll upload assets to #marketing-drafts by EOD.

kai.ops: Infra guardrails: webhook rate-limit 6/s, grant dedupe key = user.id, alert at 60% of token cap. I'll add runbook entries.

ryan.growth: Measurement plan: primary = first_prompt within 48h, secondary = 7d active and median tokens. Track via Amplitude + short SQL export. Set experiment flags and cohort property.

notif-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Fastpath launch go-live check" on 2025-10-14 10:00 UTC. :calendar:

maya.marketing: Owners: creative=jules, routing=kai, growth=ryan, eval=priya. Timeline: assets by Thu, infra by Mon, go-live Wed. Ping here when everything is green. :rocket:
